notes: Robinhood Chain 4663 only; Director/IMD. Standard fixed supply 1e27 minted whole to the deployer/factory; factory handles 80% pool, 10% remainderTo and 10% swarm as specified in the separate request economics. Hook constructor is (IPoolManager $poolManager, address $owner, address $factory): the chain's PoolManager is a constructor argument resolved by the deployer, never a compiled constant; the owner is the explicit $owner; IMD and deviceId are constants for this deployment. Mine CREATE2 salt for exact flags 0x2040 with the final constructor arguments and actual factory deployer. beforeInitialize accepts only that PoolManager with sender equal to the explicit $factory; it never binds or enables reactions. bindPool accepts only a pool the PoolManager has initialized, and renounceOwnership is disabled so administration moves only by two-step transfer. afterSwap emits relay commands; no hook fee or return delta. Other initialization and liquidity callbacks are disabled permissions and therefore are not called by PoolManager. The initialPrice is nominal schema data: the launch factory derives the opening price from the chain policy (2500 IMD cap) and deployed currency ordering. Initially enabled=false and poolBound=false. After deployment the owner must verify the exact PoolKey from the real Initialize event, call bindPool once, connect the external gateway, then call setEnabled(true). The factory must not perform these owner actions or first-swap binding. The factory-gated initialization callback resolves the reproduced admission incompatibility and counterfactual-initialization attack in job 582906e4-3ecf-48b2-ab13-e3a2c52743e8. RelayTriggered ABI and immutable relay 4/deviceId are part of the gateway interface. No contract has been deployed by this project yet.
